svg.title: Scaling Readiness Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-scaling-readiness-roadmap; chapter number: 12; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Scaling Readiness Roadmap; subtitle: Speed, breakeven math, payback and capacity before more spend; caption: Operators treat conversion and scaling as one math problem: revenue per visitor, contribution profit and CAC payback decide whether more traffic makes money.; assumptions note: Week sequencing orders the practitioners' gates; no speaker prescribed a four-week schedule. Average Shopify conversion is 1 to 3% per Davie Fogarty Mentors.; note: Sources: Chase Chappell [daDsoHXE52A @ 00:01:49; 00:23:30], Adam Callinan [VCXWZQgbKXw @ 00:25:39], Leading Social [KpmUvCBEKK4 @ 00:01:48], Frankly eCommerce [CCtunt0iWMU @ 00:07:53].; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Fix page speed; deliverable: Compress high-resolution images with Tiny Image Optimizer before other CRO work; gate: Each 1-second delay costs 7% of conversion (Chase Chappell); week: Week 2; title: Set breakeven ROAS by budget; deliverable: Breakeven ROAS from fixed costs and variable margin at each planned spend level; gate: Runs 22 at $10k spend, 6 at $50k and 4 at $100k (Adam Callinan); week: Week 3; title: Check CAC payback; deliverable: Payback period measured before raising budgets; gate: 30 to 60 days; six months or more means financing growth (Leading Social); week: Week 4; title: Recover carts and prove capacity; deliverable: AI SMS cart recovery plus a separate picker and packer; gate: 15-30% of carts recovered at 10-15x ROI; two points of verification before surges
